sources.name: Open Cities AI Challenge (GFDRR; Source Cooperative open-cities/ai-challenge)
sources.finding: Checked the STAC catalogues on 10 Oct 2026. Tier-1 training collections are acc, mon, ptn, kam, dar, znz and nia. Their bounding boxes are small urban patches in Accra, Monrovia, Pointe-Noire, Kampala (0.25N 32.63E), Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar and Niamey; tier 2 adds gao, kin and mah. None lies in a candidate district. Per-collection licence 'various' (znz CC-BY-4.0); README licence ODbL-1.0. Labels are building footprints only, with no agricultural storage or processing class. Fails coverage and labels for every candidate.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 (Copernicus)
sources.finding: Global, free and open, but the finest bands are 10 m. That is 10 times coarser than the 1 m detector threshold, so it fails the resolution test everywhere. It may show the largest cold-storage roofs, but that is unproven and was not tested.

sources.name: Commercial basemaps (Google, Bing, Esri World Imagery)
sources.finding: Sub-metre in many places, but these are proprietary basemaps, not open imagery. Their terms were not reviewed in detail. They are treated as failing the open training-and-publishing licence test.
